title: Squanto taken to Málaga, England and home, 1614–19
summary: Thomas Hunt, a captain in John Smith's 1614 fishing voyage, seized Tisquantum and some two dozen other Patuxet and Nauset men and sold them at Málaga. Tisquantum was freed by friars, reached England, and spent years there, then crossed to Newfoundland and came back to New England in 1619 to find the Patuxet dead of plague. The dates between 1614 and 1619 are not firm.

events.label: Patuxet empty
events.text: He came home to find the village of Patuxet empty. An epidemic in 1616–19 had killed most of the coastal peoples, and the Pilgrims who settled there in 1620 found cleared fields and no people.
